title: One Phase Is Enough: Sim-to-Real Transfer with Direct Visual Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled impressive robotic behaviors, yet deploying policies directly from vision remains challenging. A common approach first trains a teacher policy with RL using privileged state observations, then distills its behavior into a vision-based student via imitation. However, the resulting student can substantially underperform its teacher. Directly training visual policies with RL offers a promising alternative, but learning task-relevant visual representations from scratch can be sample-inefficient, making one-phase visual RL intractable. We propose DRIFT, a simple recipe for efficient one-phase visual RL using image observations available at test time. Our key insight is to use frozen, pretrained foundation vision encoders, allowing RL to focus on learning control from existing visual representations. translated_title: 一个阶段足矣：基于直接视觉强化学习的仿真到现实迁移
translated_abstract: 仿真到现实强化学习已经实现了令人瞩目的机器人行为，但直接基于视觉部署策略仍具挑战性。一种常见方法是先用特权状态观测通过强化学习训练教师策略，再通过模仿学习将其行为蒸馏到基于视觉的学生策略中。然而，所得的学生策略表现可能大幅逊于教师策略。直接用强化学习训练视觉策略是一种有前景的替代方案，但从零开始学习任务相关的视觉表征往往样本效率低下，使得单阶段视觉强化学习难以实现。我们提出DRIFT，一种利用测试时可获取的图像观测来实现高效单阶段视觉强化学习的简单方案。我们的核心洞察是使用冻结的预训练基础视觉编码器，使强化学习能够专注于基于现有视觉表征学习控制。冻结编码器避免了通过视觉骨干网络进行代价高昂的反向传播，而其预训练所获得的表征……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DRIFT方法，通过使用冻结的预训练基础视觉编码器实现高效的单阶段视觉强化学习，直接从图像观测完成仿真到现实的策略迁移，无需传统的“教师-学生”蒸馏流程。
en_tdlr: DRIFT enables efficient one-phase sim-to-real visual reinforcement learning by leveraging frozen pretrained foundation vision encoders, allowing RL to focus on learning control directly from existing visual representations without teacher-student distillation.
